name: Number of set partitions of [n] such that each subset is sum-free.
comment: The count can be built constructively by listing all possible sum-free sets of partitions into collections containing {1, ..., n}. For n>1, iterate over the previous generation and insert n into each partition if the result is sum-free, and also append n to the end as its own partition. See Example.
